findings.claim: 10-K 風險因子：被動安全市場競爭激烈，公司表示能否持續創新並把握新興技術是維持競爭力的關鍵；文件未點名任何可取代氣囊／安全帶的替代技術。
findings.source: SEC EDGAR 10-K FY2025 Item 1A Risk Factors
findings.excerpt: Our ability to compete successfully depends, in large part, on our success in continuing to innovate and manufacture products that have commercial success with our customer and end-consumers

findings.claim: Autoliv 與 Adient 合作因應自駕車非傳統座椅姿態的被動安全設計，安全帶仍是主要約束手段（舊資料，2018）。
findings.source: DBusiness: Adient, Autoliv to Collaborate on Vehicle Seating Challenges for Autonomous Vehicles
